arrival.speaker: Morty
arrival.text: Rick? Mom says something exploded. Twice.

arrival.speaker: Morty
arrival.text: Rick, if you're faking being asleep, I swear...

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Rick? Rick, wake up. What happened to the gun?

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: Mmrgh. Morty? Why is the floor so loud?

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: Gun's busted. Three parts flew out. Crystal, canister, chip. Don't make me say it twice.

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: I won't. I'll be asleep. Gun's got one charge left. Point it at your problems.

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: That portal went back to Blips and Chitz. Where I was. Don't judge me. Crystal landed there.

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: Canister bounced on to the shrimp place. Chip went to the Citadel. Lost and found. Zzzz.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Why is it always shrimp? Why is it never something normal?

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: I'm doing it right now, Morty. I'm delegating. Start with the crystal. Blips and Chitz. Zzzz.

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: Wake me when you're a hero. Or dead. Whichever's quieter.

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: Zzzz... crystal... arcade... don't touch the thing that hums... zzzz.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Rick's portal gun. It's cracked. And it's humming.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Mom said not to touch anything that hums. Maybe I should wake Rick first.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: One charge left. The screen says... "BLIPS AND CHITZ". Of course it does.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Okay. Okay. I can do this. I can probably do this.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Empty. The only way now is through the portal.
